items.name: Ash-Wood Hoplite Dory
items.description: An eight-foot ash shaft tipped with a leaf-shaped bronze spearhead and balanced by a four-sided bronze sauroter spike.

mythologicalLore.note: Ash from Mount Pelion was favored by heroic spear-makers; Chiron cut the great spear of Peleus from its slopes.

items.name: Bronze Xiphos
items.description: A double-edged, leaf-shaped bronze short sword suited for close-quarters fighting once the spear is spent.

mythologicalLore.note: The straight thrusting blade carried in a baldric across the chest.

items.name: Yew Hunting Bow
items.description: A curved wooden bow crafted from mountain yew, strung with twisted sinew.

mythologicalLore.note: Hunters of the Cithaeron forest dedicated their bows to Artemis Agrotera.

items.name: Cyclopean Heavy Dory
items.description: A massive ash-wood spear forged with an archaic bronze blade as wide as a spade, recovered from the Mycenaean royal shaft graves.

mythologicalLore.note: The heavy spears of the Heroic Age, too ponderous for later generations of mortals to lift.

items.name: Fennel Thyrsus of the Maenads
items.description: A giant fennel wand spiraled with ivy and topped with an aromatic pinecone, capable of striking with supernatural Dionysian ecstasy.

mythologicalLore.note: The sacred wand of the bacchants, dripping honey and striking with divine frenzy.

items.name: Argive Aspis Shield
items.description: A deep, bowl-shaped wooden shield faced with beaten bronze sheet. Fitted with a central forearm porpax strap and antilabe handgrip.

mythologicalLore.note: The Carians invented shield grips and blazons, perfected by Argive armories.

items.name: Layered Linothorax
items.description: A body cuirass composed of laminated sheets of heavy linen glued into a stiff, resilient torso defense with shoulder flaps.

mythologicalLore.note: Ajax son of Oileus fought renowned in a linen corslet rather than heavy bronze.

items.name: Muscled Bronze Cuirass of Thebes
items.description: Two interlocking plates of heavy bronze hammered to mimic an athletic heroic torso, bearing the embossed crest of the Kadmeian dragon.

mythologicalLore.note: The bell-shaped bronze corslet worn by the champions of Boeotia and Mycenae.

items.name: Fragment of the Nemean Lion's Pelt
items.description: A thick mantle fashioned from a flank of the Nemean Lion's golden hide. Bronze blades glide across its bristles without leaving a scratch.

mythologicalLore.note: Herakles flayed the beast using its own razor talons, wearing the pelt as an impenetrable aegis.

items.name: Mycenaean Boar-Tusk Helmet
items.description: A conical leather cap layered with dozens of split and polished wild boar tusks, lined with soft wool felt.

mythologicalLore.note: Autolycus stole this helmet from Amyntor; Odysseus wore it on the nocturnal reconnaissance of the Trojan camp.

items.name: Bronze Corinthian Helmet
items.description: Beaten from a single bronze ingot, covering the cheeks and nose with narrow eye slits. Intimidating and protective, though muffling distant sounds.

mythologicalLore.note: The iconic helmet worn by hoplites across the Aegean.

items.name: Woolen Traveler's Chlamys
items.description: A rectangular wool mantle pinned at the right shoulder with a bronze fibula, standard dress for messengers and hunters.

mythologicalLore.note: The cloak of Hermes and the Attic ephebes.

items.name: Consecrated Laurel of Tempe
items.description: A woven crown of sacred laurel gathered from the Vale of Tempe where Apollo purified himself after slaying Python.

mythologicalLore.note: Worn by the victors of the Pythian Games, guarding the mind from hubris and madness.

items.name: Pendant of the Sacred Omphalos
items.description: A small carved marble pendant depicting the knotted woolen fillets (agrenon) binding the Navel of the Earth at Delphi.

mythologicalLore.note: The stone where the two eagles released by Zeus from the ends of the earth met in flight.

items.name: Seven-Reed Syrinx of Pan
items.description: A rustic shepherd's panpipe crafted from seven reeds of descending length joined with beeswax, capable of playing haunting melodies.

mythologicalLore.note: Pan formed the syrinx from the transformed water nymph Syrinx upon the river Ladon.

items.name: Consecrated Silver Obol of the Styx
items.description: An archaic silver obol stamped with the Gorgoneion, blessed to pay passage across the River Acheron.

mythologicalLore.note: Placed in the mouth of deceased mortals so Charon would row them across the Underworld waters.

items.name: Dragon's Tooth of Ares
items.description: A serrated, fossilized ivory fang taken from the jaws of the Ismenian Dragon slain by Cadmus at the Spring of Ares.

mythologicalLore.note: Sown into freshly furrowed earth, it summons armed earth-born warriors (Spartoi) to fight alongside the bearer.

items.name: Vial of Lernaean Hydra Venom
items.description: An alabaster vial of thick, pitch-black venom scraped from the gall of the Lernaean Hydra, whose fumes are deadly to gods and men.

mythologicalLore.note: Herakles tipped his arrows with this venom; even Chiron could not heal its excruciating burning.

items.name: Phial of Castalian Spring Water
items.description: Pure spring water gathered before sunrise from the sacred cleft between the Phaedriades rocks at Delphi.

mythologicalLore.note: Used by the Pythian priesthood to purify ritual impurity (miasma) and clear the prophetic mind.

items.name: Aryballos of Pramnian Wine
items.description: A small globular terracotta vessel filled with fragrant, dark Pramnian wine suitable for restoring spirits or pouring a sacred libation to the gods.

mythologicalLore.note: Pramnian wine was renowned for its strength and used in heroic offerings.

items.name: Herbal Salve of Epidaurus
items.description: An unguent compounded from mountain thyme, beeswax, and crushed dittany from Crete, blessed in the tradition of Asclepius.

mythologicalLore.source: Virgil, Aeneid 12.412; Theophrastus, Enquiry into Plants
mythologicalLore.note: Cretan dittany was reputed to drive out spear-points and knit wounded flesh.

items.name: Dried Attic Figs & Barley Cakes
items.description: Sweet sun-dried figs and toasted barley cakes, the staples of marching warriors and herdsmen.

mythologicalLore.note: The nourishing bread of rural Attica and Boeotia.

items.name: Archaic Bronze Bell of Hermes
items.description: A small cast-bronze bell hung from the horn of Daidalos' prize sacrificial ram, incised with archaic dedication letters to Hermes Kriophoros.

mythologicalLore.note: Bells were dedicated in pastoral shrines to ward off malicious daimones and wolves.

items.name: Fragment of the Cadmean Stone
items.description: A slate fragment bearing ancient Phoenician-derived letters describing the sowing of the Dragon's teeth at Thebes.

mythologicalLore.note: Cadmus brought the art of letters (Phoinikeia grammata) to Boeotia.

items.name: Common Wolfhide Boots
items.description: Supple laced boots fashioned from cured mountain wolf pelt, offering warmth and sure footing.

items.name: Reinforced Wolfskin Boots
items.description: Double-layered wolfhide footwear reinforced with bronze studs along the heel and arches.

mythologicalLore.note: Cithaeronian wolves were noted by ancient hunters for their speed through rugged limestone crags.

items.name: Frost-Treader Wolfhide Boots
items.description: Masterwork winter boots imbued with the swiftness and enduring frost-resistance of mountain alpha wolves.

mythologicalLore.note: Mount Cithaeron harbored fierce wolves that roamed the snowline above Plataea.

items.name: Nemean Pelt Cloak
items.description: A heavy feline pelt draped over the back and shoulders, deflecting slicing blows.

mythologicalLore.note: Heracles wore the skin of the Cithaeronian lion before slaying the Nemean beast.

items.name: Hydra-Scale Vambraces
items.description: Forearm guards fashioned from the iridescent scales of the Lernaean serpent.

mythologicalLore.note: The Hydra of Lerna was raised by Hera as a menace to Heracles; its hide was steeped in lethal venom.

items.name: Gorgon-Eye Ward
items.description: A bronze pendant bearing the snarling visage of Medusa, warding the wearer against terror.

mythologicalLore.note: Apotropaic gorgoneia were carved upon shields and pendants to turn evil upon the foe.

items.name: Bronze Phalanx Greaves
items.description: Anatomically shaped bronze leg guards springing tight around the calf and shin.

items.name: Embossed Leather Girdle
items.description: A stout leather war belt faced with bronze plaques securing the lower abdomen.

items.name: Hoplite Field Gloves
items.description: Tanned oxhide gauntlets protecting palms and knuckles when grasping spear shafts.

items.name: Plataean Signet Ring
items.description: A carved signet ring depicting the heifer of Plataea, recognized throughout Boeotia.

items.name: Delphic Ring of Truth
items.description: A consecrated silver band engraved with the tripod of Apollo Pythios.

mythologicalLore.note: The Amphictyonic League guarded the sacred sanctuary and treasury of Apollo at Delphi.

items.name: Forged Bronze Spaulders
items.description: Curved bronze shoulder pauldrons riveted with leather under-straps.

mythologicalLore.note: Layered bronze shoulder guards protected hoplite ranks against descending spear thrusts.

items.name: Apothecary Healing Draught
items.description: A glass phial of distilled Cretan dittany, willow bark, and sweet thyme honey that rapidly stitches wounds.

items.name: Hephaestian Smithing Kit
items.description: Tongs, forging hammer, and crucible suited for bronze and iron smithing.

items.name: Daedalian Artifice Kit
items.description: Calipers, delicate bronze screwdrivers, gears, and balance weights.

items.name: Textile & Leatherworking Kit
items.description: Bone needles, sinew spools, awls, and scraper shears.

items.name: Asklepian Alchemist Kit
items.description: Agate mortar, glass alembic, copper vials, and precision herb shears.

items.name: Pygmalion Sculptor Kit
items.description: Hardened chisels, wooden mallet, pumice stone, and polishing rags.

items.name: Orphic Instrument Kit
items.description: Gauged gut stringer, peg reamer, tuning fork, and carving knives.

items.name: Hierophant Scribing Kit
items.description: Egyptian reed pens, gall inkpot, bone folder, and gum arabic binder.

items.name: Fieldcraft & Gathering Kit
items.description: Iron trowel, foraging sickle, mineral chisel, and specimen satchel.

items.name: Cypriot Bronze Ingot
items.description: Refined copper alloyed with tin from Cyprus for forging armaments.

items.name: Celestial Bronze Ingot
items.description: Mined from Mount Olympus and quenched in the River Lethe.

mythologicalLore.note: The Bronze Race wrought all their implements and arms from heaven-blessed bronze.

items.name: Grey Wolf Pelt
items.description: Thick winter pelt harvested from wolves roaming Mount Cithaeron.

items.name: Bristle Boar Tough Hide
items.description: Rugged, scarred wild boar hide capable of blunting slashes.

items.name: Cretan Mountain Dittany
items.description: The miraculous healing herb of Mount Ida that rapidly stitches flesh.

items.name: Root of Sacred Moly
items.description: A milk-white blossom with black roots given by Hermes to ward off enchantments.

mythologicalLore.note: Hermes plucked the black-rooted, white-blossomed herb moly to preserve Odysseus from enchantment.

items.name: Pentelic White Marble Block
items.description: Flawless fine-grained white marble with faint veins of iron.

mythologicalLore.note: Mount Pentelikon was the famed source of brilliant white marble for classical temples and sculpture.

items.name: Mountain Tortoiseshell
items.description: Hollowed convex carpace prized by Hermes for constructing resonant lyres.

mythologicalLore.note: Hermes scooped out the shell of a mountain tortoise to invent the seven-stringed lyre.

items.name: Drakon Serpent Fang
items.description: An ivory tooth plucked from an earth-born drakon.

mythologicalLore.note: Cadmus sowed the teeth of the sacred dragon of Ares into the Boeotian earth to sprout the Spartoi.

items.name: Egyptian Papyrus Reeds
items.description: Cross-laminated river reed sheets pressed into resilient parchment scrolls.

items.name: Bronze Leaf Dagger
items.description: A short leaf-shaped bronze blade worn at the belt, favoured by scouts and cutpurses.

items.name: Olive-Wood Staff
items.description: A seasoned staff of wild olive carried by seers, pilgrims and wandering sages.

items.name: Bronze Harvest Sickle
items.description: A curved bronze sickle used in rites of the harvest and the mysteries.

items.name: Bronze Fishing Trident
items.description: A three-pronged bronze spear of the Aegean fishermen, sacred to Poseidon.

items.name: Bronze Lockpicks
items.description: A roll of thin bronze picks and tension wires for coaxing open tumbler locks.

items.name: Pitch-Pine Torches
items.description: A bundle of resin-soaked pine torches for exploring caves and labyrinths.

items.name: Scholar's Papyrus Scrolls
items.description: Rolled papyrus scrolls, reed pens and soot ink for recording discoveries and arguments.
